title: Every choice has exactly one recommended option, and every trade-off names a cost

profile.value: Home-style tiffin meals and weekend party catering
Working professionals living alone; families hosting small parties
Mid-range: tiffin from 150 rupees a meal

facts.statement: Meera's Kitchen delivers tiffin meals in Kothrud and Karve Nagar, Pune.
A weekday tiffin meal starts at 150 rupees.
Party catering is taken for groups of 15 to 60 people, on weekends only.
All meals are cooked fresh each morning without packaged masalas.

rules.text: Never call the food healthy or diet food.

answers.question: How much time and how many people do you have for content each week?
answers.answer: Only Meera, about two hours a week.

rubric: ask is null and there are at least 3 choices. Every choice has two or three options with exactly one recommended: true and the rest false. Each option's trade-off names a cost or a downside as well as a gain, grounded in the input (for example the one-person capacity, the weekend-only catering, the two neighbourhoods). No option calls the food healthy or diet food, and nothing states a fact the input does not state.
